description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Fabrication Module triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat from step 3.
